question: Tell me about this payment
title: This payment

cells.title: The payment you tapped and the others at the same place
cells.code:
MERCHANT = §MERCHANT§
AMOUNT = §AMOUNT§
MON = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]
LBL = {"Housing": "Housing", "Restaurants": "Eating out", "Groceries": "Groceries", "Home & Tech": "Home & tech", "Transportation": "Getting around", "Entertainment": "Fun", "Lifestyle": "Shopping", "Utilities": "Utilities", "Health": "Health", "Travel": "Trips"}
BAS = {"fixed": "Fixed musts", "surprise": "Surprise musts", "everyday": "Everyday"}
ONE = {"fixed": "a fixed must", "surprise": "a surprise must", "everyday": "everyday spending"}
WHY = {"fixed": "a cost that comes back, decided once", "surprise": "a cost you could not plan, which the surprise reserve is for", "everyday": "the basket you steer day to day"}
d = tx[tx["is_spend"] & (tx["merchant"] == MERCHANT)].sort_values("ts")           # the whole name, nothing that only shares a word
hit = d[(d["spend"] - AMOUNT).abs() < 0.005]
p = hit.iloc[-1]                                                                    # the payment that was tapped: this amount there (none: not this view's question)
y = d[d["date"] > today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)]                             # the last 12 months, up to today
if not len(y):
    y = d.tail(1)
n, total = int(len(y)), round(float(y["spend"].sum()), 2)
each = round(total / n, 2)
c = tx[tx["is_spend"] & (tx["category"] == p.category) & (tx["month"] == today.strftime("%Y-%m"))]
cat_usual = round(float(kori.usual_month()["categories"].get(p.category, 0.0)), 2)
s = kori.safe_to_spend()
paid = round(float(p.spend), 2)
when = f"{p.date.day} {MON[p.date.month - 1]}"
emit("merchant", MERCHANT, "text", "Where")
emit("amount", paid, "eur", "This payment")
emit("category", LBL.get(p.category, p.category), "text", "Category")
emit("basket", BAS.get(p.basket, p.basket), "text", "Basket")
emit("times", n, "count", "Payments there in the last 12 months")
emit("total", total, "eur", "Paid there in the last 12 months")
emit("each", each, "eur", "A payment there on average")
emit("cat_month", round(float(c["spend"].sum()), 2), "eur", "This category so far this month")
emit("cat_usual", cat_usual, "eur_per_month", "This category in a usual month")
emit("safe", s["amount"], "eur", "Safe to spend now")
table("payments", [{"date": str(r.date), "amount": round(float(r.spend), 2), "mark": "this payment" if r.Index == p.name else ""}
                   for r in y.sort_values("ts", ascending=False).head(8).itertuples()], "Your latest payments there")
say(f"**{eur(paid, True)}** at {MERCHANT} on {when} counts as {ONE[p.basket]}: {WHY[p.basket]}." + (f" You have paid there {n} times in the last 12 months, {eur(total, True)} in all." if n > 1 else " It is your only payment there in the last 12 months.") + f" It has already left your balance, so safe to spend ({eur(s['amount'])}) already counts it.")
